name: [Jujutsu🤞🏻] DUEL Warriors
desc:
✨ Brand New Ranked Event is Now Live!
🌟 Introducing the "Ban & Pick" System! Ban the skills you hate the most, and choose your exclusive build to crush your enemies!
Get ready for thrilling PvP battles! ⚔️ Mix and match hundreds of weapons and dozens of skills freely to duel your opponents!
🔥 Dive into the chaotic "Infinite Fire" mode, or join the epic "Flame Mountain" brawl and experience the intense fight with 100 players on screen!
🗡️ Arsenal —— Longswords, Katanas, Spears, Greatswords, Scythes!
⚡ Skill Pool —— Magma Bombs, (Ruyi Jingu Bang / The Golden Cudgel); even classic anime abilities are included!
📱 Play Across All Platforms! No matter what device you use, jump into the battle right now!
